Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable transparent 2D painted game sprite for a camera-rotated scenic motorcycle commute.

Front-facing side elevation, level camera, no perspective convergence. The bay represents a plausible 2.8 m span and a 0.9 m high railing.
Scene/backdrop: isolated object only; genuinely transparent background.
Subject: weathered chestnut-brown bridge guardrail, complete posts and connected upper and lower rails, flat grounded post bottoms.

Color palette: weathered warm dark chestnut, muted walnut shadows, sun-faded brown highlights.
Materials/textures: substantial timber planks and square posts; subtle grain and age, cleanly joined wood.
Constraints: this is a sprite cutout, not a 3D model or render. Flat front view, no depth perspective. Keep the rails continuous to both posts so repeating the bay leaves no visible gap. No text, labels or watermark.
